name: health-monitoring-report
title: Health monitoring report
for_each: select id, ref from tests where report_on is not null order by ref

sections.title: Worker and business
sections.note: The contents a health monitoring report must have: HSW (GRWM) Regulations 2016 reg 38(2) (NZ), WHS Regulations r 374 (AU).
sections.sql: select w.name as worker, w.dob as date_of_birth, e.name as business, e.address, t.practitioner, t.done_on as date_of_monitoring from tests t join workers w on w.id = t.worker_id join employers e on e.id = t.employer_id where t.id = $1

sections.title: Result
sections.sql: select tt.name as test, t.kind, t.value, tt.unit, t.result, case when t.disease_indicated then 'Yes' else 'No' end as disease_indicated, case when t.remedial_recommended then 'Yes' else 'No' end as remedial_measures, t.recommendation, t.fit as can_continue_the_work from tests t join test_types tt on tt.code = t.test_code where t.id = $1

sections.title: Who has a copy
sections.note: Not disclosed to anyone else without the worker's written consent (NZ reg 42(2), AU r 378(2)).
sections.sql: select t.report_on as report_obtained, t.worker_copy_on as worker_copy, coalesce(t.regulator_on::text, case when r.regulator_needed then 'NOT YET' else 'not required' end) as regulator_copy from tests t join v_reports r on r.id = t.id where t.id = $1

name: recall-list
title: Health monitoring recall list
for_each: select id, name from employers order by code

sections.title: Due in the next 45 days or overdue
sections.sql: select worker, grp as group_code, test_name as test, due_on, standing, rule from v_due where employer_id = $1 and due_on <= current_date + 45 order by due_on, worker

sections.title: Exposure groups and their programme
sections.sql: select g.code, g.name, gt.test_code as test, gt.hazard_code as hazard, coalesce(gt.interval_months::text || ' months', 'set by law') as every from groups g join group_tests gt on gt.group_id = g.id where g.employer_id = $1 order by g.code, gt.test_code

name: lead-removal-notice
title: Removal from lead risk work
for_each: select id, ref from removals order by ref

sections.title: Removal
sections.note: WHS Regulations r 415: the regulator is notified as soon as practicable. r 417: return only below the return level and with a doctor's clearance.
sections.sql: select r.ref, w.name as worker, w.dob as date_of_birth, e.name as business, r.removed_on, r.reason, r.regulator_on as regulator_notified, r.returned_on, r.cleared_by from removals r join workers w on w.id = r.worker_id join employers e on e.id = w.employer_id where r.id = $1

sections.title: Blood lead results
sections.sql: select t.ref, t.done_on, t.value as blood_lead_ug_dl, t.result, t.practitioner from tests t join removals r on r.worker_id = t.worker_id where r.id = $1 and t.test_code = 'blood-lead' order by t.done_on desc limit 6

name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id, ref from invoices order by ref

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.ref, e.name as employer, i.period_from, i.period_to, i.raised_on, i.due_on, i.currency, i.subtotal_cents, i.gst_cents, i.total_cents from invoices i join employers e on e.id = i.employer_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Tests
sections.sql: select t.ref, w.name as worker, tt.name as test, t.done_on, t.price_cents as amount_cents, i.currency from tests t join workers w on w.id = t.worker_id join test_types tt on tt.code = t.test_code join invoices i on i.id = t.invoice_id where t.invoice_id = $1 union all select d.ref, w.name, 'Drug and alcohol: ' || d.reason || ', ' || d.sample, d.collected_at::date, d.price_cents, i.currency from dna_tests d join workers w on w.id = d.worker_id join invoices i on i.id = d.invoice_id where d.invoice_id = $1 order by 4, 1
